run_mcp_todo_server: run the MCP todo tracking server that provides todo list management tools via FastMCP
add_todo_item: add a new todo item with a title and optional description to the todo list
list_todos: list all todo items optionally filtering out completed ones from the todo list
complete_todo: mark a todo item as completed by its ID and record the completion timestamp
delete_todo: delete a todo item from the list by its ID and return the deleted item
